about.title: Why Birthday Dance Videos Are the Best Gift
about.label: The Perfect Celebration Content
about.description: Forget generic birthday cards. An AI dance video of the birthday person is personal, hilarious, and something they'll watch over and over. It's the gift that keeps on giving.

items.title: Deeply Personal
items.description: Using their actual photo makes it uniquely theirs. No generic template — this is a birthday greeting made specifically for them, featuring them as the star.

items.title: Party Entertainment
items.description: Play the birthday dance video at the party for instant laughs. It works as an icebreaker, a toast accompaniment, or the highlight of the celebration.

items.title: Shareable Memory
items.description: Send it in the group chat, post it on social media, or save it as a digital keepsake. Birthday dance videos get shared and rewatched for years.

items.title: Upload Their Photo
items.description: Choose a clear photo of the birthday person. Funny photos, formal portraits, and candid shots all work great. The more unexpected the photo, the funnier the result.

items.title: Pick a Dance Style
items.description: Choose from fun, energetic dances for a hilarious result, or gentle sways for a more sentimental feel. TikTok viral dances are popular for younger recipients.

items.title: Share the Surprise
items.description: Generate the video in about 30 seconds. Send it directly, play it at the party, or post it on social media with a birthday message.

items.question: What's the best photo to use for a birthday video?
items.answer: The funniest results come from formal or serious photos — work headshots, passport photos, or stern-looking portraits. The contrast between the serious photo and the dance moves creates the best comedy.

items.question: Can I make a birthday video for a child?
items.answer: Yes! Birthday dance videos are perfect for kids. Use a clear photo of the child and choose a fun or baby dance template. It's a great way to celebrate their special day.

items.question: How do I share the birthday video?
items.answer: Download the HD video and share it however you like — text message, WhatsApp, email, social media, or play it on a screen at the party. The video has no watermarks.

items.question: Can I make a group birthday video?
items.answer: The AI works best with single-subject photos. For a group birthday video, create individual dance videos for each person and compile them into a montage using a video editor.

items.question: Is this appropriate for all ages?
items.answer: Absolutely! All our dance templates are family-friendly. Birthday dance videos work for kids, teens, adults, and seniors. The fun is universal.
